title: Post-Task AI Analysis Proposal Foundation
goal: Add a guarded, disabled-by-default post-task analysis path that can create reviewed AI proposals without executing them.
scope: Wire a narrow post-task analysis service after task completion only when explicitly enabled, using existing run/task/finding/inventory context and the AI reasoning ledger. Store observations, hypotheses, and proposed next steps as pending proposals, but do not auto-dispatch, auto-approve, broaden scope, or bypass the existing approval model.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md's reasoning loop requires post-tool analysis, but AegisPT must add it behind existing safety controls and audit storage.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Post-task analysis may create pending proposals only. It must not execute, approve, expand scope, alter findings, or queue tasks directly.

success_criteria: AI analysis is disabled by default and skipped cleanly when no provider is configured.
Any generated proposal is stored as pending review and remains non-executing.
Out-of-scope targets or unsupported tools are blocked before proposal storage.
Provider failure leaves task completion and findings unchanged.
Tests cover disabled, provider-failure, blocked-out-of-scope, and pending-proposal cases.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Post-task AI analysis is opt-in and safe by default.
No proposal can bypass scope, approval, pack, or runtime binding gates.

before_promotion: AI reasoning ledger foundation is completed and logged.
Allowed proposal shape and blocked action classes are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with post-task AI analysis changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the pending-proposal-only reasoning baseline.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
